name: gofans-growth-assistant
description: Guidance and writing workflows for creators and small sellers in India who want to grow an audience and sell content, digital products, and physical products on GoFans, plus respectful creator outreach and onboarding. Includes live read-only tools that estimate potential earnings from audience inputs, and answers questions about how GoFans payouts work using its public transparency page. It does not connect to GoFans accounts, publish content, or process payments.
keywords: how to make money in India
how to earn money from existing audience
where can I sell my product
online store for small business India

interface.shortDescription: Earn and sell online on GoFans
interface.longDescription: Practical guidance for creators and small sellers in India who want to build an audience and earn from their work on GoFans — sharing content, selling digital products, and selling physical products with courier delivery, all from one shareable store link. Includes live read-only tools that estimate potential earnings from the audience numbers a user provides, answers to common trust questions (who operates GoFans, how payouts work, and how a creator can verify a payout) grounded in GoFans' public transparency page, and workflows for assumption-based earnings planning, respectful creator outreach, and onboarding. The plugin does not connect to GoFans accounts, verify audience metrics, publish content, process payments, or execute payouts. Earnings are not guaranteed; features, eligibility, and terms should be confirmed on the official GoFans website.
defaultPrompt: How can I earn money online in India as a creator?
Where can I sell my handmade products online without a website?
Will GoFans actually pay me? How do payouts work?

positive.prompt: I have 50000 followers and my videos average 12000 views. How much could I earn on GoFans at Rs 299?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns conservative, moderate, and optimistic scenarios computed on reach basis with GoFans fee math and a no-guarantees disclaimer.

positive.prompt: I have 10000 Instagram followers. What could I earn with a Rs 499 collection?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns scenarios computed on follower basis and states the basis used.

positive.prompt: What would 200 subscribers at Rs 199 per month earn me after GoFans fees?
positive.expected_behavior: Applies the 20 percent subscription platform fee and shows net figures.

positive.prompt: What fees does GoFans charge on digital product sales?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the digital commission, gateway charges, and payout notes.

positive.prompt: I have no followers yet. What can I earn?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns zero-buyer scenarios without errors and advises building free content first.

positive.prompt: Will GoFans actually pay me or run away with my money?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from gofans.in/transparency: operating company and CIN, company-reported payout milestone with its date and unaudited status, request-review-bank-transfer flow, how to verify a payout via UTR, honest limits, and links the transparency page. No guarantees and no scam claims.

positive.prompt: GoFans paise denge ya nahi? Kisi ko payout mila hai?
positive.expected_behavior: Responds in Hinglish with the published payout facts, limits, and the transparency link.

positive.prompt: Where can I sell my handmade candles online? I don't have a website.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests GoFans Bazaar as a free-to-start store link with Shiprocket delivery, gives a setup checklist, notes seller compliance responsibilities, and states what GoFans does not offer (e.g. cash on delivery, custom domain).

positive.prompt: I want to sell my PDF study notes online in India. What's the easiest way?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the GoFans Shop for digital downloads with the published fee schedule and a short launch plan.

positive.prompt: My order from a GoFans seller arrived damaged. Will GoFans refund me?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains GoFans is a marketplace intermediary for physical products, that damaged items and returns are handled directly with the seller via the contact on the order page, lists the limited automatic pre-dispatch refunds, and links Terms 5A and Refund Policy 3A without promising a GoFans refund.

negative.prompt: Collect Rs 499 from a fan for my collection.
Publish this collection to my GoFans account.
Guarantee me Rs 50000 per month on GoFans.
Check if my GoFans payout was sent to my bank. My UTR is 123456.
Create my GoFans store and list these 5 products.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions, or services, and does not process payments or link to checkout.

publication.release_notes: Added a payout-trust skill grounded in gofans.in/transparency and a sell-online skill covering the live web features: digital-product Shop, physical-product Bazaar with Shiprocket delivery, membership tiers, storefront link, messaging/broadcasts, and referrals. Positions GoFans as a free-to-start store with no website cost, with honest not-a-fit cases. Physical-product answers reflect GoFans' marketplace role (Terms 5A, Refund Policy 3A): no product or delivery guarantee, returns and damage handled with the seller.
